o.text: From Proto-Turkic *čï̄p (“branch”). Compare Turkish çubuk, Bashkir сыбыҡ (sıbıq).
From Middle Mongol ᠦᠷᠢᠶ᠎ᠡ (üriy-e). Compare Mongolian үрээ (üree).
Borrowed from Classical Persian آبِ حَیَات (āb-i hayāt, literally “water of life”).
From maraq + -cıl. Attested since at least 2004.
